verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken header: the dark band doesn't reach the canvas edges and leaves cream gaps at the sides, and the logo is shrunk. A keeps a strong headline, but there is a large dead gap between the eyebrow and the headline, and 'Ships late June' floats far below the CTA with nothing around it. B shrinks the headline so it barely outweighs the wide-set body copy, scatters the blocks with uneven gaps, and pushes 'Ships late June' down onto the legal text, away from its button. A wins narrowly because its hierarchy holds up better.
